name: KinElo
description: KinElo connects Claude to a user's KinElo movie account. It can search movies, show bookmarks and rated movies, fetch detailed movie metadata, recommend what to watch next, browse global rankings, and review followers or following when privacy settings allow. Users can also add bookmarks and mark movies as watched.

_published_faq.name: How do I add KinElo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add KinElo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kinelo-mcp-uddmbd7l7q-uc.a.run.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the KinElo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: KinElo provides these MCP tools: get_bookmarked_movies, add_bookmark, set_watched, search_movies, get_rated_movies, get_recommended_movies, get_global_leaderboard, get_movie_details, get_followers, get_following, and get_users_rated_movies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to KinElo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to KinElo in media on the Manufact MCP catalog include CardChain AI, FreqBlog Music Metadata, Futrumi, QuizHP, and Wistia.
KinElo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
KinElo is developed by KinElo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
